To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the body and the environment play a central role in cognitive development; (b) body morphology, soft materials and the environment can be used to guide cognitive development in an adaptive way; and (c) the body is not just a static structure, but can be used in an active way to guide cognitive development.
the physical properties of the material of our body, such as softness and elasticity, are important for the way we develop our cognition and behavior.
“Embodiment, in particular soft embodiment, is crucial for cognition, as it provides the basis for a bottom-up approach to cognition.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the physical properties of a robot’s body affect the way it interacts with its physical environment, and how this interaction in turn influences the robot’s cognitive development.
understanding how the physical properties of the brain, body, and environment interact to produce cognition.
understanding the relationship between the structure, function, and development of the human brain and body, and their role in cognitive development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cognition is not just about computation, but also about the physical structure of the body and its interaction with the environment, and the material properties of the body and the environment.
the brain is not enough.
cognition is embodied and embedded, and is also morphologically and materially embodied.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the physical structure of the body, the soft materials, and the morphology of the body play a significant role in the development of cognition and intelligence.
the body is the brain.
cognition is not a process, but a property of a system, which emerges from the interaction between body and environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the physical body and the material properties of the environment are important factors in the development of cognition and intelligence.
we need to understand how cognition is grounded in our physical body, and how it is influenced by the physical properties of our body.
we need to take into account not only the body morphology, but also the material properties of the soft body, in the study of cognition and learning in robotics.
